maria: heads-up team — i'm finalizing the docs changelog entry for tomorrow's push. main items: fallback routing snippet, streaming-embeddings truncation known issue, a redirect for /docs/dedicated/autoscale, and a couple small SDK snippet fixes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4499
sam: reading. prefer 3 terse bullets in the whatsnew: 1) added fallback routing snippet, 2) known issue: streaming embeddings may truncate >4MB, 3) SDK example fixes. machine-parsable pls.

chris: pushed a tiny go example fix (iterator + defer close). verify code rendering in the PR preview.

lee: filed PR #4500 to add a temporary redirect for /docs/dedicated/autoscale -> /docs/dedicated/scaling. mark under Known issues as "redirect in progress."

jen: added a 4-line node snippet for the whatsnew box. keeping it compact. pasting here for sanity-check:```js
// minimal fallback routing
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood(process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY)
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-kitefish-v1', fallbacks: ['redwood-kitefish-v1-quant','gpt-compatible-fallback'] })
```

maria: thanks — add a one-line parenthetical after the snippet: (Quantized fallback may tokenize differently; verify prompt/stop tokens). also link to quantization guide and migration steps.

sam: editorial note: avoid words like "improved" or "enhanced" in whatsnew. use verbs like "added", "fixed", "documented".

chris: for changelog bullets i suggest exact text (one-liners) so partners can scrape: "Added: fallback routing example + snippet (link)", "Known issue: streaming embeddings may truncate on payloads >4MB — workaround (link)", "Fixed: SDK example fixes (go/node/rust)".

lee: LGTM from infra side — redirect PR included.

jen: LGTM — left a tiny wording tweak on the PR for the whatsnew phrasing.

maria: timeline: i'll update PR tonight with the tokenizer parenthetical + redirect note, request final LGTM by 07:30 UTC, stage at 09:00 UTC. will ping when staging is live. :rocket:
docs-bot: reminder — staging deploy scheduled for 09:00 UTC tomorrow after signoff.
